name: Override 2026–27 · route planning
description: Route-planning experiment: the 36 cups and 37 field pins are fixed, immovable obstacles. They cannot be pushed or grasped. Robot dynamics and the hinged toggles still simulate. Use the full Override preset to test interactions with the field's game pieces.
geometry_accuracy: Official CAD layout and the same collision approximations as the full field. Fixed game pieces intentionally change contact behavior for route planning; this preset is not a full-game dynamics or scoring test.
